'''2017 EGP Day 2 Joe Phillips DS Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Phillips]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V)|V0-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere) Phillips.txt |Download]]
